```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Global Settings
# ============================================================
set.seed(2025)


BETA_SET <- 0.4      
ALPHA <- 0.1
N_CAL_FIXED <- 20    


nsyn_list_exp1 <- c(20, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000)




my_cols <- c("1.SCP"="black", 
             "2.RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)"="blue", 
             "3.SPI"="purple", 
             "4.Synthetic scores (SPI)"="red", 
             "5.Reference scores (RSA-CP)"="orange")

# ============================================================
# 2. Data Generation
# ============================================================
get_data_lognormal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3)
  X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 1.5*log(X1) + abs(X2) + X3*X4 + 0.5*X5^2; sigma <- 0.5 + 0.5*X1
  Y <- mu + sigma*rnorm(n); list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

get_data_bimodal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- runif(n,-2,2); X2 <- runif(n,-2,2); X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + X2 - 0.5*X3; cluster <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
  epsilon <- cluster*rnorm(n, 4, 1.0) + (1-cluster)*rnorm(n, 0, 0.5)
  Y <- mu + epsilon; list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# --- Simulators ---
# M3/M4 
get_m3_syn_lognormal <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3); X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  # predict 
  pred_score <- predict(model$resid_model, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  
  # Noise Simulation
  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * rnorm(n, 8, 2)
  pmax(0, pred_score + rnorm(n, 0, 1.0) + shock)
}

get_m3_syn_bimodal <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- runif(n,-2,2); X2 <- runif(n,-2,2); X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + X2 - 0.5*X3; cluster <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)

  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * runif(n, 10, 15)
  epsilon_noisy <- cluster*rnorm(n, 4, 2.0) + (1-cluster)*rnorm(n, 0, 1.5)
  Y_syn <- mu + epsilon_noisy + shock
  
  # predict 
  pred_y <- predict(model$main, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  abs(Y_syn - pred_y)
}

# --- Support Functions ---
train_models <- function(X_tr, Y_tr) {
  df_tr <- data.frame(y=Y_tr, X_tr); fit_main <- lm(y~., data=df_tr)
  abs_resid <- abs(fit_main$residuals); fit_resid <- lm(abs_resid~., data=data.frame(abs_resid, X_tr))
  list(main=fit_main, resid_model=fit_resid)
}
get_scores <- function(model, X, Y) abs(Y - predict(model, newdata=data.frame(X)))
apply_scale_ot_map <- function(S_new, S_source, S_target) {
  mu_src <- mean(S_source); mu_tgt <- mean(S_target)
  if(abs(mu_src)<1e-9) mu_src<-1e-9; S_new * (mu_tgt/mu_src)
}
get_spi_quantile <- function(S_mapped_real, S_syn, alpha, beta) {
  values <- c(S_mapped_real, S_syn)
  w_r <- (1-beta)/length(S_mapped_real); w_s <- beta/length(S_syn)
  weights <- c(rep(w_r, length(S_mapped_real)), rep(w_s, length(S_syn)))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)
  ord <- order(values); cum_weights <- cumsum(weights[ord])
  values[ord][which(cum_weights >= (1-alpha))[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Time Consuming function
# ============================================================
run_exp_nsyn_final <- function() {
  n_cal <- N_CAL_FIXED
  n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_bm <- get_data_bimodal_true(50000); test_bm <- get_data_bimodal_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 1 (N_syn 20->3000)...")
  for(t in 1:n_trials) {
    if(t%%20==0) cat(".")
    idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
    
    # --- 1. LogNormal Baseline ---
    m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
    # M1 Time (Quantile only)
    t0<-Sys.time(); q1_ln<-quantile(s_r_ln, probs=ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal, type=1); tm1_ln<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
    
    # --- 2. Bimodal Baseline ---
    m_bm <- train_models(dp_bm$X[idx_tr,], dp_bm$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_bm <- get_scores(m_bm$main, dp_bm$X[idx_ca,], dp_bm$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_bm <- get_scores(m_bm$main, test_bm$X, test_bm$Y)
    # M1 Time
    t0<-Sys.time(); q1_bm<-quantile(s_r_bm, probs=ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal, type=1); tm1_bm<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))

    for(n_syn in nsyn_list_exp1) {
      # Record M1
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="1.SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln, Time=tm1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="1.SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_bm<=q1_bm), Width=2*q1_bm, Time=tm1_bm))
      
      # === LogNormal Methods ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      
      # M2: Gamma-SPI (Fast)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g)
      q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="2.RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln), Time=tm2))
      
      # M3: Feat-SPI (Slow due to predict)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln) # predict inside
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f)
      q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="3.SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln), Time=tm3))

      # M4: Pure Feat (Slow)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_tmp<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln) # predict inside
      q4<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE)
      tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="4.Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))

      # M5: Pure Gamma (Fast)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE)
      tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="5.Reference scores (RAS-CP)", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))

      # === Bimodal Methods ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_bm); va<-var(s_r_bm); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      
      # M2: Gamma (Fast)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_g)
      q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="2.RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_bm), Time=tm2))
      
      # M3: Feat (Slow)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_bimodal(n_syn, m_bm)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_f)
      q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="3.SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_bm), Time=tm3))

      # M4: Pure Feat (Slow)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_tmp<-get_m3_syn_bimodal(n_syn, m_bm)
      q4<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE)
      tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="4.Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=mean(s_t_bm<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))
      
      # M5: Pure Gamma (Fast)
      t0<-Sys.time()
      s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE)
      tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="5.Reference scores (RAS-CP)", Cov=mean(s_t_bm<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Setting 2
# ============================================================
run_exp_ncal_final <- function() {
  ncal_list <- c(15, 30, 60, 120, 240); n_syn <- 5000; n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_bm <- get_data_bimodal_true(50000); test_bm <- get_data_bimodal_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 2 (N_cal)...")
  for(n_cal in ncal_list) {
    cat(".")
    for(t in 1:n_trials) {
      idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
      
      # LogNormal
      m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
      q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal, type=1)
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln)
      
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln)
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_ln<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_ln<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="1.SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="2.RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="3.SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="4.Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="5.Reference scores (RAS-CP)", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
      
      # Bimodal
      m_bm <- train_models(dp_bm$X[idx_tr,], dp_bm$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_bm <- get_scores(m_bm$main, dp_bm$X[idx_ca,], dp_bm$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_bm <- get_scores(m_bm$main, test_bm$X, test_bm$Y)
      q1_bm <- quantile(s_r_bm, probs=ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal, type=1)
      mu<-mean(s_r_bm); va<-var(s_r_bm); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_bimodal(n_syn, m_bm)
      
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_bm)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_bm, s_r_bm, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_bm)
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_bm<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_bm<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="1.SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_bm<=q1_bm), Width=2*q1_bm))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="2.RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="3.SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="4.Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Bimodal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="5.Reference scores (RAS-CP)", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 5. Execute & Plot (Separated into 3 Big Figures)
# ============================================================
res_exp1 <- run_exp_nsyn_final()
res_exp2 <- run_exp_ncal_final()

# Summary
summ1 <- res_exp1 %>% group_by(Dataset, N_syn, Method) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_Cov=mean(Cov), Mean_Width=mean(Width), SD_Width=sd(Width), Total_Time=sum(Time, na.rm=T))
summ1_ln <- summ1 %>% filter(Dataset=="LogNormal")
summ1_bm <- summ1 %>% filter(Dataset=="Bimodal")
summ2 <- res_exp2 %>% group_by(Dataset, N_cal, Method) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_Cov=mean(Cov), Mean_Width=mean(Width))

common_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
  plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.position = "right"
)

# --- Figure 1: LogNormal Results ---
p1a <- ggplot(summ1_ln, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Mean_Cov, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.9, linetype="dashed", color="gray40") + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="A. Validity (Coverage)", x=NULL, y="Coverage") + common_theme

p1b <- ggplot(summ1_ln, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Mean_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="B. Efficiency (Width)", x=NULL, y="Width") + common_theme

p1c <- ggplot(summ1_ln, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=SD_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="C. Stability (SD)", x="N", y="SD of Width") + common_theme

# Time Plot: Remove M1 because it's 0, focus on M2-M5
p1d <- ggplot(summ1_ln %>% filter(Method != "1.SCP"), aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Total_Time, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="D. Computation Time (Total)", x="N", y="Time (s)") + common_theme

#fig1 <- (p1a | p1b) / (p1c) + plot_layout(guides="collect") +
#  plot_annotation(title = paste0("LogNormal Case (N_cal=", N_CAL_FIXED, ")"))
#print(fig1)

# --- Figure 2: Bimodal Results ---
p2a <- ggplot(summ1_bm, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Mean_Cov, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.9, linetype="dashed", color="gray40") + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="A. Validity (Coverage)", x=NULL, y="Coverage") + common_theme

p2b <- ggplot(summ1_bm, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Mean_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="B. Efficiency (Width)", x=NULL, y="Width") + common_theme

p2c <- ggplot(summ1_bm, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=SD_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="C. Stability (SD)", x="N", y="SD of Width") + common_theme

p2d <- ggplot(summ1_bm %>% filter(Method != "1.Standard"), aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Total_Time, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="D. Computation Time (Total)", x="N", y="Time (s)") + common_theme

#fig2 <- (p2a | p2b) / (p2c ) + plot_layout(guides="collect") +
#  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Bimodal Case (N_cal=", N_CAL_FIXED, ")"))
#print(fig2)

# --- Figure 3: N_cal Results ---
p3a <- ggplot(summ2, aes(x=factor(N_cal), y=Mean_Cov, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + facet_wrap(~Dataset) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.9, linetype="dashed", color="gray40") + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="A. Validity vs m", x="m", y="Coverage") + common_theme + theme(legend.position="bottom")

p3b <- ggplot(summ2, aes(x=factor(N_cal), y=Mean_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + facet_wrap(~Dataset, scales="free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +
  labs(title="B. Efficiency vs m", x="m", y="Width") + common_theme + theme(legend.position="bottom")

fig3 <- (p3a | p3b) + plot_layout(guides="collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Figure 3: Impact of Calibration Data Size") & theme(legend.position="bottom")
print(fig3)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Global Settings
# ============================================================
set.seed(2026)

# A. 
BETA_SET <- 0.4      
ALPHA <- 0.05        # Target 95% Coverage

N_CAL_FIXED <- 20   

# B. N_syn Range 
nsyn_list_exp1 <- c(20, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000)

# C. Colorboard

my_cols <- c("SCP"="black", 
             "RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)"="blue", 
             "SPI"="purple", 
             "Synthetic scores (SPI)"="red", 
             "Reference scores (RSA-CP)"="orange")


# ============================================================
# 2. DGP (Data Generating Processes)
# ============================================================

# Case 1: LogNormal
get_data_lognormal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3)
  X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 1.5*log(X1) + abs(X2) + X3*X4 + 0.5*X5^2; sigma <- 0.5 + 0.5*X1 
  Y <- mu + sigma*rnorm(n)
  list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# Case 2: Student's t (Heavy-Tailed, df=3)
get_data_student_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2)
  X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  # Error is t-distributed (Heavy tails)
  epsilon <- rt(n, df=3) 
  Y <- mu + epsilon
  list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Simulators (The "Noisy" Generators)
# ============================================================

# M3 Simulator for LogNormal
get_m3_syn_lognormal <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3); X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  pred_score <- predict(model$resid_model, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))

  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * rnorm(n, 8, 2)
  pmax(0, pred_score + rnorm(n, 0, 1.0) + shock)
}

# M3 Simulator for Student-t
get_m3_syn_student <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  
  # Simulator generates t-distributed errors + noise
  epsilon_noisy <- rt(n, df=3) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.5) 
  # 5% Rare large shock
  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * runif(n, 5, 10)
  Y_syn <- mu + epsilon_noisy + shock
  
  pred_y <- predict(model$main, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  abs(Y_syn - pred_y)
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Helpers
# ============================================================
train_models <- function(X_tr, Y_tr) {
  df_tr <- data.frame(y=Y_tr, X_tr); fit_main <- lm(y~., data=df_tr)
  abs_resid <- abs(fit_main$residuals); fit_resid <- lm(abs_resid~., data=data.frame(abs_resid, X_tr))
  list(main=fit_main, resid_model=fit_resid)
}
get_scores <- function(model, X, Y) abs(Y - predict(model, newdata=data.frame(X)))
apply_scale_ot_map <- function(S_new, S_source, S_target) {
  mu_src <- mean(S_source); mu_tgt <- mean(S_target)
  if(abs(mu_src)<1e-9) mu_src<-1e-9; S_new * (mu_tgt/mu_src)
}
get_spi_quantile <- function(S_mapped_real, S_syn, alpha, beta) {
  values <- c(S_mapped_real, S_syn)
  w_r <- (1-beta)/length(S_mapped_real); w_s <- beta/length(S_syn)
  weights <- c(rep(w_r, length(S_mapped_real)), rep(w_s, length(S_syn)))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)
  ord <- order(values); cum_weights <- cumsum(weights[ord])
  values[ord][which(cum_weights >= (1-alpha))[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# 5. Experiment 1: N_syn (LogNormal vs Student-t)
# ============================================================
run_exp_nsyn_final <- function() {
  n_cal <- N_CAL_FIXED
  n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  
  # Data Pools
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 1 (N_syn 20->3000)...")
  for(t in 1:n_trials) {
    if(t%%20==0) cat(".")
    idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
    
    # --- 1. LogNormal Baseline ---
    m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
    
    t0<-Sys.time()

    prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
    q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    tm1_ln <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
    
    # --- 2. Student-t Baseline ---
    m_st <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
    
    t0<-Sys.time()
    q1_st <- quantile(s_r_st, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    tm1_st <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))

    for(n_syn in nsyn_list_exp1) {
      # M1
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln, Time=tm1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SCP", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q1_st), Width=2*q1_st, Time=tm1_st))
      
      # === LogNormal Methods ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      # M2 Gamma
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln), Time=tm2))
      # M3 Feat
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln), Time=tm3))
      # Pure
      t0<-Sys.time(); q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn,mu^2/va,va/mu); q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Reference scores (RSA-CP)", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))

      # === Student-t Methods ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_st); va<-var(s_r_st); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      # M2 Gamma
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_st), Time=tm2))
      # M3 Feat
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_student(n_syn, m_st)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_st), Time=tm3))
      # Pure
      t0<-Sys.time(); q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn,mu^2/va,va/mu); q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Reference scores (RSA-CP)", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Experiment 2: m
# ============================================================
run_exp_ncal_final <- function() {
  ncal_list <- c(20, 30, 40, 80, 160); n_syn <- 3000; n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 2 (N_cal)...")
  for(n_cal in ncal_list) {
    cat(".")
    for(t in 1:n_trials) {
      idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
      
      # LogNormal
      m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
      prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
      q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=prob_val, type=1)
      
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln)
      
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln)
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_ln<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_ln<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Reference scores (RSA-CP)", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
      
      # Student-t
      m_st <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
      q1_st <- quantile(s_r_st, probs=prob_val, type=1)
      
      mu<-mean(s_r_st); va<-var(s_r_st); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_student(n_syn, m_st)
      
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_st)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_st)
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_st<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_st<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q1_st), Width=2*q1_st))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="RSA-CP (OT) (Ours)", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Synthetic scores (SPI)", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Reference scores (RSA-CP)", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 7. Execute & Plot
# ============================================================
res_exp1 <- run_exp_nsyn_final()
res_exp2 <- run_exp_ncal_final()

# Summary
summ1 <- res_exp1 %>% group_by(Dataset, N_syn, Method) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_Cov=mean(Cov), Mean_Width=mean(Width), SD_Width=sd(Width), Total_Time=sum(Time, na.rm=T))
summ1_ln <- summ1 %>% filter(Dataset=="LogNormal")
summ1_st <- summ1 %>% filter(Dataset=="Student-t")
summ2 <- res_exp2 %>% group_by(Dataset, N_cal, Method) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_Cov=mean(Cov), Mean_Width=mean(Width))

common_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
  plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(size=10),
  legend.title = element_text(size=11, face="bold"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)

# --- Figure 1: LogNormal Results ---
p1a <- ggplot(summ1_ln, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Mean_Cov, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) +

p1c <- ggplot(summ1_ln, aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=SD_Width, color=Method, group=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_color_manual(values=my_cols) +

p1d <- ggplot(summ1_ln %>% filter(Method != "SCP"), aes(x=factor(N_syn), y=Total_Time, color=Method, group=Method)) +

fig1 <- (p1a | p1b) / (p1c | p1d) + plot_layout(guides="collect") +

fig3 <- (p3a | p3b) + plot_layout(guides="collect") +
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Global Settings
# ============================================================
set.seed(2026)

# A. Parameters
BETA_SET <- 0.4
ALPHA <- 0.05        # 95% Target
N_CAL_FIXED <- 20    # Small Calibration

# B. N_syn Range (20 -> 3000)
nsyn_list_exp1 <- c(20, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000)

# C. Method Renaming
# 1 -> Standard
# 2 -> Para-SPI (Our Fancy Name)
# 3 -> SPI (The Baseline)
# 4 -> SynData_Only
# 5 -> Gamma_Only

my_cols_new <- c(
  "Standard"      = "black", 
  "Para-SPI"      = "blue",    # Ours (was Gamma-SPI)
  "SPI"           = "purple",  # Theirs (was Feat-SPI)
  "SynData_Only"  = "red",     # was Pure-Feat
  "Gamma_Only"    = "orange"   # was Pure-Gamma
)


method_levels <- c("Standard", "Para-SPI", "SPI", "SynData_Only", "Gamma_Only")

# ============================================================
# 2. DGP (Data Generating Processes)
# ============================================================
get_data_lognormal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3)
  X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 1.5*log(X1) + abs(X2) + X3*X4 + 0.5*X5^2; sigma <- 0.5 + 0.5*X1 
  Y <- mu + sigma*rnorm(n); list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

get_data_student_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2)
  X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  epsilon <- rt(n, df=3) 
  Y <- mu + epsilon; list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Simulators
# ============================================================
get_m3_syn_lognormal <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3); X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  pred_score <- predict(model$resid_model, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * rnorm(n, 8, 2)
  pmax(0, pred_score + rnorm(n, 0, 1.0) + shock)
}

get_m3_syn_student <- function(n, model) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  epsilon_noisy <- rt(n, df=3) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.5) 
  shock <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05) * runif(n, 5, 10)
  Y_syn <- mu + epsilon_noisy + shock
  pred_y <- predict(model$main, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  abs(Y_syn - pred_y)
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Helpers
# ============================================================
train_models <- function(X_tr, Y_tr) {
  df_tr <- data.frame(y=Y_tr, X_tr); fit_main <- lm(y~., data=df_tr)
  abs_resid <- abs(fit_main$residuals); fit_resid <- lm(abs_resid~., data=data.frame(abs_resid, X_tr))
  list(main=fit_main, resid_model=fit_resid)
}
get_scores <- function(model, X, Y) abs(Y - predict(model, newdata=data.frame(X)))
apply_scale_ot_map <- function(S_new, S_source, S_target) {
  mu_src <- mean(S_source); mu_tgt <- mean(S_target)
  if(abs(mu_src)<1e-9) mu_src<-1e-9; S_new * (mu_tgt/mu_src)
}
get_spi_quantile <- function(S_mapped_real, S_syn, alpha, beta) {
  values <- c(S_mapped_real, S_syn)
  w_r <- (1-beta)/length(S_mapped_real); w_s <- beta/length(S_syn)
  weights <- c(rep(w_r, length(S_mapped_real)), rep(w_s, length(S_syn)))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)
  ord <- order(values); cum_weights <- cumsum(weights[ord])
  values[ord][which(cum_weights >= (1-alpha))[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# 5. Run Exp 1: N_syn (With Renaming Logic inside)
# ============================================================
run_exp_nsyn_final <- function() {
  n_cal <- N_CAL_FIXED
  n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 1 (N_syn)...")
  for(t in 1:n_trials) {
    if(t%%20==0) cat(".")
    idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
    
    # 1. LogNormal
    m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
    
    t0<-Sys.time()
    prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
    q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    tm1_ln <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
    
    # 2. Student-t
    m_st <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
    
    t0<-Sys.time()
    q1_st <- quantile(s_r_st, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    tm1_st <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))

    for(n_syn in nsyn_list_exp1) {
      # Save M1 (Standard)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln, Time=tm1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q1_st), Width=2*q1_st, Time=tm1_st))
      
      # === LogNormal ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      # M2 (Para-SPI)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Para-SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln), Time=tm2))
      # M3 (SPI)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln), Time=tm3))
      # M4 (SynData_Only)
      t0<-Sys.time(); q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SynData_Only", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))
      # M5 (Gamma_Only)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn,mu^2/va,va/mu); q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Gamma_Only", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))

      # === Student-t ===
      mu<-mean(s_r_st); va<-var(s_r_st); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      # M2 (Para-SPI)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm2<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_g)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Para-SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q2), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_st), Time=tm2))
      # M3 (SPI)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_student(n_syn, m_st)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      tm3<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs")); s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_f)
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SPI", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q3), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_st), Time=tm3))
      # M4 (SynData_Only)
      t0<-Sys.time(); q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm4<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="SynData_Only", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q4), Width=2*q4, Time=tm4))
      # M5 (Gamma_Only)
      t0<-Sys.time(); s_tmp<-rgamma(n_syn,mu^2/va,va/mu); q5<-quantile(s_tmp,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); tm5<-as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(),t0,units="secs"))
      results<-rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_syn=n_syn, Method="Gamma_Only", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q5), Width=2*q5, Time=tm5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Run Exp 2: N_cal (Renamed)
# ============================================================
run_exp_ncal_final <- function() {
  ncal_list <- c(20, 30, 40, 80, 160); n_syn <- 3000; n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Exp 2 (N_cal)...")
  for(n_cal in ncal_list) {
    cat(".")
    for(t in 1:n_trials) {
      idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
      prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
      
      # LogNormal
      m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
      q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=prob_val, type=1)
      mu<-mean(s_r_ln); va<-var(s_r_ln); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_lognormal(n_syn, m_ln)
      
      # M2 (Para-SPI)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_ln)
      # M3 (SPI)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_ln)
      # M4/M5
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_ln<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_ln<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Para-SPI", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SynData_Only", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Gamma_Only", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
      
      # Student-t
      m_st <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr]); s_r_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca]); s_t_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
      q1_st <- quantile(s_r_st, probs=prob_val, type=1)
      mu<-mean(s_r_st); va<-var(s_r_st); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
      s_s_g<-rgamma(n_syn, mu^2/va, va/mu); s_s_f<-get_m3_syn_student(n_syn, m_st)
      
      # M2 (Para-SPI)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); q2<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_g, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_g); cov2<-mean(s_t_m<=q2); wid2<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q2,s_s_g,s_r_st)
      # M3 (SPI)
      s_r_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); q3<-get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m<-apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_f); cov3<-mean(s_t_m<=q3); wid3<-2*apply_scale_ot_map(q3,s_s_f,s_r_st)
      # M4/M5
      q4<-quantile(s_s_f,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov4<-mean(s_t_st<=q4); wid4<-2*q4
      q5<-quantile(s_s_g,1-ALPHA,type=8,names=FALSE); cov5<-mean(s_t_st<=q5); wid5<-2*q5
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Standard", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q1_st), Width=2*q1_st))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Para-SPI", Cov=cov2, Width=wid2))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SPI", Cov=cov3, Width=wid3))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="SynData_Only", Cov=cov4, Width=wid4))
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", N_cal=n_cal, Method="Gamma_Only", Cov=cov5, Width=wid5))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 7. Execute & Plot (Layout: 3 panels per Figure)
# ============================================================
res_exp1 <- run_exp_nsyn_final()
res_exp2 <- run_exp_ncal_final()


summ1 <- res_exp1 %>% group_by(Dataset, N_syn, Method) %>%
```

###Noise approach

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Gobal Settings
# ============================================================
set.seed(2026)

# 固定参数
BETA_SET <- 0.4
ALPHA <- 0.05        # 95% Target
N_CAL_FIXED <- 20    # Real Cal
N_SYN_FIXED <- 1000  # Syn_data

# *** Noise Level ***
noise_levels <- c(0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0)

# ============================================================
# 2. DGP (数据生成)
# ============================================================
get_data_lognormal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3)
  X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 1.5*log(X1) + abs(X2) + X3*X4 + 0.5*X5^2; sigma <- 0.5 + 0.5*X1 
  Y <- mu + sigma*rnorm(n); list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

get_data_student_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2)
  X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  epsilon <- rt(n, df=3) 
  Y <- mu + epsilon; list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Simulation Distributions
# ============================================================

# LogNormal： pred + normal_noise
get_m3_syn_lognormal_var_noise <- function(n, model, noise_scale) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3); X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  pred_score <- predict(model$resid_model, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  

  added_noise <- rnorm(n, 0, noise_scale)
  pmax(0, pred_score + added_noise)
}

# Student-t ： pred + normal_noise
get_m3_syn_student_var_noise <- function(n, model, noise_scale) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X_syn <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X_syn) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  

  epsilon_noisy <- rt(n, df=3) + rnorm(n, 0, noise_scale)
  
  Y_syn <- mu + epsilon_noisy
  pred_y <- predict(model$main, newdata=data.frame(X_syn))
  abs(Y_syn - pred_y)
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Helpers
# ============================================================
train_models <- function(X_tr, Y_tr) {
  df_tr <- data.frame(y=Y_tr, X_tr); fit_main <- lm(y~., data=df_tr)
  abs_resid <- abs(fit_main$residuals); fit_resid <- lm(abs_resid~., data=data.frame(abs_resid, X_tr))
  list(main=fit_main, resid_model=fit_resid)
}
get_scores <- function(model, X, Y) abs(Y - predict(model, newdata=data.frame(X)))
apply_scale_ot_map <- function(S_new, S_source, S_target) {
  mu_src <- mean(S_source); mu_tgt <- mean(S_target)
  if(abs(mu_src)<1e-9) mu_src<-1e-9; S_new * (mu_tgt/mu_src)
}
get_spi_quantile <- function(S_mapped_real, S_syn, alpha, beta) {
  values <- c(S_mapped_real, S_syn)
  w_r <- (1-beta)/length(S_mapped_real); w_s <- beta/length(S_syn)
  weights <- c(rep(w_r, length(S_mapped_real)), rep(w_s, length(S_syn)))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)
  ord <- order(values); cum_weights <- cumsum(weights[ord])
  values[ord][which(cum_weights >= (1-alpha))[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# 5. Run Experiment
# ============================================================
run_exp_noise_vs_standard <- function() {
  n_cal <- N_CAL_FIXED
  n_syn <- N_SYN_FIXED
  n_trials <- 100
  results <- data.frame()
  
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Noise Sensitivity Exp...")
  
  for(t in 1:n_trials) {
    if(t%%20==0) cat(".")
    idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)
    prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
    
    # --- 1. LogNormal ---
    m_ln <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_ln <- get_scores(m_ln$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
    
    # Baseline: Standard (Real Cal)
    q1_ln <- quantile(s_r_ln, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    res_std_ln <- data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", Noise=NA, Method="Standard (Real Cal)", Cov=mean(s_t_ln<=q1_ln), Width=2*q1_ln)

    # --- 2. Student-t ---
    m_st <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr])
    s_r_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca])
    s_t_st <- get_scores(m_st$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
    
    # Baseline: Standard (Real Cal)
    q1_st <- quantile(s_r_st, probs=prob_val, type=1)
    res_std_st <- data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", Noise=NA, Method="Standard (Real Cal)", Cov=mean(s_t_st<=q1_st), Width=2*q1_st)

    # Loop over noise levels
    for(ns in noise_levels) {
      
      # LogNormal SPI
      s_s_f_ln <- get_m3_syn_lognormal_var_noise(n_syn, m_ln, noise_scale = ns)
      s_r_m <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f_ln)
      q_spi <- get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f_ln, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_ln, s_r_ln, s_s_f_ln)
      # Save
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="LogNormal", Noise=ns, Method="SPI (Method 3)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q_spi), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q_spi, s_s_f_ln, s_r_ln)))
      # Add Standard Baseline for this row (Use Noise=ns just for plotting alignment)
      results <- rbind(results, transform(res_std_ln, Noise=ns))

      # Student-t SPI
      s_s_f_st <- get_m3_syn_student_var_noise(n_syn, m_st, noise_scale = ns)
      s_r_m <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_r_st, s_r_st, s_s_f_st)
      q_spi <- get_spi_quantile(s_r_m, s_s_f_st, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      s_t_m <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_t_st, s_r_st, s_s_f_st)
      # Save
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset="Student-t", Noise=ns, Method="SPI (Method 3)", Cov=mean(s_t_m<=q_spi), Width=2*apply_scale_ot_map(q_spi, s_s_f_st, s_r_st)))
      # Add Standard Baseline
      results <- rbind(results, transform(res_std_st, Noise=ns))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Plotting
# ============================================================
res_noise <- run_exp_noise_vs_standard()


summ_noise <- res_noise %>% group_by(Dataset, Noise, Method) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_Cov=mean(Cov), Mean_Width=mean(Width))

common_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)


my_colors <- c("Standard (Real Cal)" = "black", "SPI (Method 3)" = "purple")
my_linetypes <- c("Standard (Real Cal)" = "dashed", "SPI (Method 3)" = "solid")

# --- Plot 1: Coverage vs Noise ---
p_cov <- ggplot(summ_noise, aes(x=Noise, y=Mean_Cov, color=Method, linetype=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1.2) + 
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.95, linetype="dotted", color="gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset) +
  scale_color_manual(values=my_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=my_linetypes) +
  labs(title="A. Validity: Impact of Generator Noise", 
       subtitle="SPI maintains validity even as generator degrades",
       x="Generator Noise Level (Sigma)", y="Coverage Rate") + common_theme

# --- Plot 2: Width vs Noise ---
p_wid <- ggplot(summ_noise, aes(x=Noise, y=Mean_Width, color=Method, linetype=Method)) +
  geom_line(size=1.2) + 
  geom_point(size=2) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, scales="free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values=my_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=my_linetypes) +
  labs(title="B. Efficiency: Impact of Generator Noise", 
       subtitle="SPI width increases slightly to compensate for noise, but stays efficient",
       x="Generator Noise Level (Sigma)", y="Average Interval Width") + common_theme

# Combine
fig_noise_robustness <- p_cov / p_wid + plot_layout(guides="collect") & theme(legend.position="bottom")

print(fig_noise_robustness)
```












```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. Gobal Settings
# ============================================================
set.seed(2026)

BETA_SET <- 0.4
ALPHA <- 0.03        # 95% Target
N_CAL_FIXED <- 10    
N_SYN_FIXED <- 3000  
N_TRIALS <- 100      

# ============================================================
# 2. DGP (Data Generation Processes)
# ============================================================
get_data_lognormal_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- rlnorm(n, 0, 0.5); X2 <- rt(n, 3)
  X3 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- 0.6*X4 + 0.8*rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 1.5*log(X1) + abs(X2) + X3*X4 + 0.5*X5^2; sigma <- 0.5 + 0.5*X1 
  Y <- mu + sigma*rnorm(n); list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

get_data_student_true <- function(n) {
  X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2); X2 <- runif(n, -2, 2)
  X3 <- rnorm(n); X4 <- rnorm(n); X5 <- rnorm(n)
  X <- cbind(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5); colnames(X) <- paste0("X",1:5)
  mu <- 2*X1 + 1.5*X2 - X3
  epsilon <- rt(n, df=3) 
  Y <- mu + epsilon; list(X=X, Y=Y)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. 辅助函数
# ============================================================
train_models <- function(X_tr, Y_tr) {
  df_tr <- data.frame(y=Y_tr, X_tr); fit_main <- lm(y~., data=df_tr)
  list(main=fit_main)
}
get_scores <- function(model, X, Y) abs(Y - predict(model, newdata=data.frame(X)))

apply_scale_ot_map <- function(S_new, S_source, S_target) {
  mu_src <- mean(S_source); mu_tgt <- mean(S_target)
  if(abs(mu_src)<1e-9) mu_src<-1e-9; S_new * (mu_tgt/mu_src)
}

get_spi_quantile <- function(S_mapped_real, S_syn, alpha, beta) {
  values <- c(S_mapped_real, S_syn)
  w_r <- (1-beta)/length(S_mapped_real); w_s <- beta/length(S_syn)
  weights <- c(rep(w_r, length(S_mapped_real)), rep(w_s, length(S_syn)))
  weights <- weights/sum(weights)
  ord <- order(values); cum_weights <- cumsum(weights[ord])
  values[ord][which(cum_weights >= (1-alpha))[1]]
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Generation Distribution
# ============================================================

# A. Gamma 
gen_gamma <- function(n, scores) {
  mu <- mean(scores); va <- var(scores); if(va<1e-9) va<-1e-9
  shape <- mu^2/va; scale <- va/mu
  rgamma(n, shape=shape, scale=scale)
}

# B. Normal 
gen_normal <- function(n, scores) {
  mu <- mean(scores); sd_val <- sd(scores)
  raw <- rnorm(n, mean=mu, sd=sd_val)
  pmax(0, raw) # 强制非负
}

# C. Beta 
gen_beta <- function(n, scores) {

  upper_bound <- max(scores) * 1.2 
  if(upper_bound < 1e-6) upper_bound <- 1.0
  

  scaled_scores <- scores / upper_bound
  
  #  alpha, beta
  m <- mean(scaled_scores); v <- var(scaled_scores)
  
  if(v < m*(1-m)) {
    alpha <- m * ((m*(1-m))/v - 1)
    beta_param <- (1-m) * ((m*(1-m))/v - 1)
  } else {

    alpha <- 1; beta_param <- 1
  }
  

  syn_scaled <- rbeta(n, shape1=alpha, shape2=beta_param)
  syn_scaled * upper_bound
}

# ============================================================
# 5. (Boxplot Comparison) - Fixed
# ============================================================
run_dist_comparison <- function() {
  n_cal <- N_CAL_FIXED
  n_syn <- N_SYN_FIXED
  n_trials <- N_TRIALS
  results <- data.frame()
  
  dp_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(50000); test_ln <- get_data_lognormal_true(2000)
  dp_st <- get_data_student_true(50000);   test_st <- get_data_student_true(2000)
  
  cat("Running Parametric Sensitivity Analysis...")
  
  for(t in 1:n_trials) {
    if(t%%10==0) cat(".")
    idx_tr <- 1:1500; idx_ca <- sample(1501:50000, n_cal)

    prob_val <- min(1, ceiling((n_cal+1)*(1-ALPHA))/n_cal)
    
    # --- Loop over Datasets ---
    for(d_name in c("LogNormal", "Student-t")) {
      if(d_name == "LogNormal") {
        m <- train_models(dp_ln$X[idx_tr,], dp_ln$Y[idx_tr])
        s_r <- get_scores(m$main, dp_ln$X[idx_ca,], dp_ln$Y[idx_ca])
        s_t <- get_scores(m$main, test_ln$X, test_ln$Y)
      } else {
        m <- train_models(dp_st$X[idx_tr,], dp_st$Y[idx_tr])
        s_r <- get_scores(m$main, dp_st$X[idx_ca,], dp_st$Y[idx_ca])
        s_t <- get_scores(m$main, test_st$X, test_st$Y)
      }
      
      # 1. Standard
      q_std <- quantile(s_r, probs=prob_val, type=1)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset=d_name, Trial=t, Method="SCP", Cov=mean(s_t<=q_std), Width=2*q_std))
      
      # 2. Para-SPI (Gamma)
      s_syn <- gen_gamma(n_syn, s_r)
      s_r_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_r, s_r, s_syn)
      q_spi <- get_spi_quantile(s_r_map, s_syn, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      wid_spi <- 2 * apply_scale_ot_map(q_spi, s_syn, s_r)
      s_t_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_t, s_r, s_syn)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset=d_name, Trial=t, Method="Gamma", Cov=mean(s_t_map<=q_spi), Width=wid_spi))
      
      # 3. Para-SPI (Normal)
      s_syn <- gen_normal(n_syn, s_r)
      s_r_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_r, s_r, s_syn)
      q_spi <- get_spi_quantile(s_r_map, s_syn, ALPHA, BETA_SET)
      wid_spi <- 2 * apply_scale_ot_map(q_spi, s_syn, s_r)
      s_t_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_t, s_r, s_syn)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset=d_name, Trial=t, Method="Normal", Cov=mean(s_t_map<=q_spi), Width=wid_spi))
      
      # 4. Para-SPI (Beta)
     # s_syn <- gen_beta(n_syn, s_r)
     # s_r_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_r, s_r, s_syn)

     # q_spi <- get_spi_quantile(s_r_map, s_syn, ALPHA, BETA_SET) 
     # wid_spi <- 2 * apply_scale_ot_map(q_spi, s_syn, s_r)
     # s_t_map <- apply_scale_ot_map(s_t, s_r, s_syn)
     # results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Dataset=d_name, Trial=t, Method="SPI-Beta", Cov=mean(s_t_map<=q_spi), Width=wid_spi))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Plotting (Boxplots)
# ============================================================
res_dist <- run_dist_comparison()

# ============================================================
# 6. Plotting (Boxplots with Custom Limits)
# ============================================================

# res_dist <- run_dist_comparison() 

# Reorder factors
res_dist$Method <- factor(res_dist$Method, levels=c("SCP", "Gamma", "Normal"))

common_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0, hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
  plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.position = "none"
)

# Colors
box_cols <- c("SCP"="gray70", "Gamma"="blue", "Normal"="skyblue")

# --- Plot 1: Validity (Coverage) ---
# Limit: 0.7 to 1.0
p_cov <- ggplot(res_dist, aes(x=Method, y=Cov, fill=Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, outlier.size=0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.95, linetype="dashed", color="black") +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=box_cols) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.7, 1.0)) + 
  labs(title="A. Validity: Sensitivity to Reference Distribution", 
       y="Coverage Rate", x=NULL) + common_theme

# --- Plot 2: Efficiency (Width) ---
# Limit: 0 to 60
p_wid <- ggplot(res_dist, aes(x=Method, y=Width, fill=Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, outlier.size=0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, scales="free_y") + # scales="free_y" 在这里会被 coord_cartesian 覆盖，但保留无妨
  scale_fill_manual(values=box_cols) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 30)) +
  labs(title="B. Efficiency: Sensitivity to Reference Distribution", 
       y="Interval Width", x=NULL) + common_theme

# Combine
fig_dist <- p_cov / p_wid
print(fig_dist)
```
